about: glossiness A/B on the modern dish (B): a rig for glossy ware (rig_glossy_dark.json); denoised (OIDN, after mixing)

camera.why: our choice: oblique (35 degrees up, from the photo's bottom edge), so the well, the cavetto and the lip read and the glaze shows its highlights; 840 mm with a 100 mm lens puts the dish across about 60% of the width ('fill' frames by the height, which for a dish is its 38 mm)

expose.why: the same exposure for the white glaze in A and B: A's 99th percentile, B's scaled by the well's white (mean raw G over the albedo-neutral pixels of the medallion) B/A = 1.4145
